remarks: Brand-New Luxury Construction at "The South Water Collection" a boutique offering high-end townhomes designed to elevate coastal living in Greenwich. Offers 3,000 +square feet of refined coastal living, thoughtfully designed to balance elegance, comfort, and modern functionality. Featuring 4+ bedrooms and 4.5 designer bathrooms. The sun filled home features 9 foot ceilings, a sophisticated living area anchored by a gas fireplace, and a chef's kitchen appointed with quartz countertops and custom cabinetry. The home includes a luxury primary suite with a spa-inspired bath, generous closet space, and a serene, private Courtyard setting . The finished lower level provides additional recreation space suited for media, fitness, and the 3rd level offers an office suite with 4th bedroom. Curated finishes throughout complete this exceptional offering within the South Water Collection. Great location, close to local restaurants and shops!
